name: ImageCropDialog
description:
Choose an image and crop it: drop, browse for or paste a file, position it (see
`ImageCropper`) and save. The dialog checks the file against `requirements` before it can be
cropped and hands the result to `onSave`; the application uploads it. Outside presses do not
close it, so a crop is never lost by a stray click; Cancel and Esc abort a save that is still
running.
signature: ({ trigger, open: openProp, defaultOpen, onOpenChange, file, requirements, output, aspect, aspects, shape, fields, onSave, onRemove, onReject, title, subtitle, placeholder, labels, className, }: ImageCropDialogProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aspect
props.description: Width ÷ height the crop keeps, or `"free"`. Default `"free"`.

props.name: className
props.description: Layout only, on the dialog's content.

props.name: fields
props.description: Show number fields for the crop's position and size. Default true.

props.name: file
props.description: A file to start from when the dialog opens, such as one dropped on the page.

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ cropRole: string; cropLabel: string; cropInstructions: string; freeInstructions: string; zoom: string; aspect: string; free: string; left: string; top: string; width: string; height: string; changeImage: string; chooseImage: string; dropImage: string; chooseImageFirst: string; save: string; saving: string; saved: string; notSaved: string; cancel: string; removeImage: string; removing: string; savingImage: string; saveFailed: string; removeFailed: string; anyImage: string; notSupported: (name: string, formats: string) => string; tooLarge: (name: string, size: string) => string; unreadable: (name: string) => string; tooSmall: (width: string, height: string) => string; maxFileSize: (size: string) => string; minPixels: (width: string, height: string) => string; noImage: string; chosenImage: string; replace: string; crop: string; edit: string; remove: string; addImage: string; imageRequired: string; }> | undefined

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the next open state when the trigger opens it, Cancel, Esc or the close button dismisses it, or it closes after a save or removal. Pair with `open` to control it.

props.name: onReject
props.description: Called for each file refused by the requirements, with the reason shown in the dialog.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Remove the current image; runs like `onSave`. Without it there is no Remove button.

props.name: onSave
props.description:
Save the image: upload `change.blob` (or `change.original` with `change.crop`). The dialog
shows pending until the promise settles, then ✓ and closes. If it rejects, the dialog stays
open with the error's message (write it for the person) or a generic one.

props.name: open
props.description: Controls whether the overlay is open.

props.name: output
props.description: The cropped image: size in pixels, media type (default WebP) and quality.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown in the frame until an image is chosen, such as the current one.

props.name: requirements
props.description: What an image must satisfy: types, bytes, minimum dimensions and the application's own check.

props.name: shape
props.description: `round` dims the corners a round picture will not show.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The element that opens it. Omit when controlling `open`.
